_comment: Declarative manifest of every artifact that MUST ship inside a Port Daddy release tarball. This is the single source of truth for `pd batten verify` (the fail-loud staging gate) and `pd batten imprint` (the content-addressed seal). Populated from the ACTUAL staging steps in .github/workflows/release.yml (job build-binaries). Required artifacts are declared here once instead of drifting across one-off shell assertions. `buildCmd` is informational (batten VALIDATES staging, it does not build). Paths are relative to the staged dir passed to `pd batten verify --staged-dir <dir>` (dist/ in CI).

artifacts.buildCmd: node scripts/build-single-binary.mjs --outfile=dist/pd (companion binary the pd launcher execs)
node scripts/build-single-binary.mjs --outfile=dist/pd (writes port-daddy-manifest.json next to the binary)
cp hooks/sessionstart-pilot.mjs dist/hooks/sessionstart-pilot.mjs (dependency-free Pilot steering hook)

artifacts._comment: onnxruntime-node runtime libs (libonnxruntime.*.dylib / libonnxruntime.so.1) staged by scripts/build-single-binary.mjs (#3561). Filenames are platform-specific, so this asserts the directory exists and is non-empty rather than a single file. required:false — it is a semantic-search performance enhancement; a build without onnxruntime-node must still be able to release.
